authors: Kalina Manova, Dennis Novy, Thomas Sampson, Aaron Tang
official: 官方在线 2026-09-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The year 2025 was unprecedented in the frequency, complexity, and volatility of US trade policy interventions. This column uses a new database tracking US tariff announcements during the year to show that confusion about the current state of tariff policy led to a decline in US imports that was similar in size to the reduction caused by tariff increases alone, meaning that confusion doubled the negative impact of tariffs. Product customisation, relationship trust, and partner reputation can help firms maintain trade activity during information shocks.
abstract_zh: 2025年，美国贸易政策干预的频率、复杂性和波动性达到了前所未有的程度。本文利用一个追踪该年度美国关税公告的新数据库，表明对关税政策现状的困惑导致美国进口下降，其幅度与仅因关税上调造成的减少量相当，这意味着困惑使关税的负面影响翻倍。产品定制化、关系信任及合作伙伴声誉有助于企业在信息冲击期间维持贸易活动。

title: Explaining the Predictive Performance of Police in Cases of Domestic Abuse
title_zh: 解释警方在家庭虐待案件中的预测表现
title_primary: 解释警方在家庭虐待案件中的预测表现
title_secondary: Explaining the Predictive Performance of Police in Cases of Domestic Abuse
authors: Jeffrey Grogger, Andrew Jordan, Tom Kirchmaier
official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Police in England and Wales are asked to predict the likelihood of serious recidivism in domestic abuse cases, with little support beyond a flawed questionnaire. To analyze their decisions, we first develop methods to deal with a censoring problem that arises because the officer’s prediction may change the outcome she was attempting to predict. Even after adjusting for censoring, we find predictive performance to be low, even lower in some cases than what one would expect by chance. We next ask whether their predictions represent mistakes, and provide several types of confirmatory evidence. We ask how officers formulate their predictions, and we find evidence consistent with representativeness bias, overreaction, and categorization and selective attention. We find that higher-skill officers use information not captured by the questionnaire to improve their predictions, whereas lower-skill officers use such information in ways that reduce accuracy.
abstract_zh: 英格兰和威尔士的警察被要求预测家庭暴力案件中严重再犯的可能性，而他们除了一个存在缺陷的问卷外，几乎没有其他支持工具。为了分析他们的决策，我们首先开发了处理审查问题的方法，该问题源于警官的预测可能改变她试图预测的结果。即使在调整了审查之后，我们发现预测性能仍然较低，在某些情况下甚至低于随机预期。接下来，我们探讨这些预测是否代表错误，并提供多种类型的确认性证据。我们研究警官如何形成预测，并发现与代表性偏差、过度反应以及分类和选择性注意相一致的证据。我们发现，技能较高的警官利用问卷未涵盖的信息来改进预测，而技能较低的警官使用此类信息反而降低了准确性。

title: Environmental regulation and local government debt risk
title_zh: 环境规制与地方政府债务风险
title_primary: 环境规制与地方政府债务风险
title_secondary: Environmental regulation and local government debt risk
authors: Min Liu, Jiajing Leng, Dongfa Feng
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Mitigating local government debt risk poses a significant challenge for debt governance in developing countries. However, the causal link between environmental regulation and local government debt risk remains underexplored. This study examines the causal impact of environmental regulation on local government debt risk. We leverage China’s Blue Sky Defence War as a quasi-exogenous shock to environmental regulation. In a difference-in-differences framework with unbalanced panel data from 2,491 counties between 2015 and 2023, we find that environmental regulation significantly reduces local government debt risk. We then provide evidence suggesting that environmental regulation lowers local government debt risk by enhancing repayment capacity and optimizing the debt structure. Heterogeneity analysis shows that the effect is more pronounced in regions with more implicit government debt structure, superior government credit, advanced factor markets, and lower resource dependency. Further results reveal that environmental regulation effectively promotes high-quality economic development. Overall, our findings confirm the importance of environmental regulation in managing local government debt risk and enhancing its economic benefits.
abstract_zh: 缓解地方政府债务风险是发展中国家债务治理面临的重大挑战。然而，环境规制与地方政府债务风险之间的因果关系尚未得到充分探讨。本研究考察了环境规制对地方政府债务风险的影响。我们利用中国的蓝天保卫战作为环境规制的准外生冲击。在基于2015年至2023年间2491个县的非平衡面板数据的双重差分框架中，我们发现环境规制显著降低了地方政府债务风险。随后，我们提供的证据表明，环境规制通过增强偿债能力和优化债务结构来降低地方政府债务风险。异质性分析显示，在隐性政府债务结构更突出、政府信用更优、要素市场更发达以及资源依赖度较低的地区，这一效应更为显著。进一步的结果揭示，环境规制有效促进了高质量经济发展。总体而言，我们的研究结果证实了环境规制在管理地方政府债务风险及提升其经济效益方面的重要性。

title: Perceptions of Racial Gaps, their Causes, and Ways to Reduce Them
title_zh: 种族差距的认知、成因及缩小途径
title_primary: 种族差距的认知、成因及缩小途径
title_secondary: Perceptions of Racial Gaps, their Causes, and Ways to Reduce Them
authors: Alberto Alesina, Matteo F. Ferroni, Stefanie Stantcheva
official: 官方在线 2021-11-12 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper studies how beliefs about racial inequalities and their causes vary and shape support for race-targeted and redistribution policies among Black and white Americans, including both adults and teenagers. We collect original large-scale survey data to provide new evidence on perceptions, attitudes, and policy views on racial issues and study the causal impact of information on policy views. We highlight significant heterogeneity along racial and partisan lines in perceived racial gaps in income and mobility. Yet, the biggest discrepancies are in how people explain the existence of these gaps, i.e., their perceived causes. White Democratic and Black respondents are much more likely to attribute racial inequities to systemic factors, such as adverse past and present circumstances, and want to act on them with race-targeted and general redistribution policies. White Republicans are more likely to attribute racial gaps to individual-based factors, such as individual effort or actions. These views are already deeply entrenched in teenagers, based on their race and their parents' political affiliation. A policy decomposition shows that the perceived causes of racial inequities are the strongest predictors of support for race-targeted or redistribution policies, a finding confirmed by the experimental results.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了关于种族不平等及其成因的信念如何在美国黑人与白人成年人及青少年中变化，并如何影响他们对针对种族的政策及再分配政策的支持。我们收集了原创的大规模调查数据，以提供关于种族问题的认知、态度和政策观点的新证据，并研究信息对政策观点的因果影响。我们强调了在收入和流动性方面的种族差距感知中，沿着种族和党派界限存在的显著异质性。然而，最大的分歧在于人们如何解释这些差距的存在，即他们感知的成因。白人民主党受访者和黑人受访者更可能将种族不平等归因于系统性因素，如过去和现在的不利环境，并希望通过针对种族的政策和普遍再分配政策来应对。白人共和党受访者更可能将种族差距归因于个体因素，如个人努力或行为。这些观点在青少年中已根深蒂固，基于他们的种族及父母的政治归属。一项政策分解显示，感知的种族不平等成因是支持针对种族或再分配政策的最强预测因素，这一发现得到了实验结果的证实。

title: Is drug-related violence fueling emigration from Central America?
title_zh: 毒品相关暴力是否加剧了中美洲的移民外流？
title_primary: 毒品相关暴力是否加剧了中美洲的移民外流？
title_secondary: Is drug-related violence fueling emigration from Central America?
authors: Leonardo Bonilla-Mejía, Jessica Bracco, Andrés Ham, Leonardo Peñaloza-Pacheco
official: 官方在线 2026-08-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examine how drug-related violence influences emigration choices in Central America, a region that has experienced a sharp increase in migration to the United States. Combining multiple data sources, we leverage an instrumental variables strategy that exploits local variation in proximity to drug-trafficking routes and coca production in Colombia. Our results show that rising violence increases intentions, plans, and preparations to emigrate, particularly to the United States. These migration responses are strongest among young and higher-skilled individuals. Mediation analysis suggests that these migration responses operate predominantly through declining economic activity and worsening labor-market conditions in Central America, rather than through a direct response to insecurity.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了毒品相关暴力如何影响中美洲地区的移民选择，该地区向美国的移民数量急剧增加。结合多种数据来源，我们采用工具变量策略，利用靠近毒品贩运路线及哥伦比亚古柯生产的局部差异。研究结果显示，暴力升级增加了移民的意向、计划及准备，尤其是前往美国的移民。这些移民反应在年轻及高技能人群中最为显著。中介分析表明，这些移民反应主要通过中美洲经济活动衰退和劳动力市场状况恶化发挥作用，而非直接源于对不安全感的回应。

abstract: we estimate maturity-specific demand functions and elasticities of different investors and the Fed, and integrate them into a dynamic equilibrium model of the Treasury market with risk-averse arbitrageurs. Quantifying the model reveals that (1) there is a steep downward-sloping term structure of Treasury market elasticity; (2) monetary tightening raises term premia due to arbitrageurs interacting with investors exhibiting high cross-elasticities; (3) QE has limited impact unless the Fed credibly commits to sustained balance sheet expansion.
abstract_zh: 我们估算了不同投资者及美联储的期限特定需求函数与弹性，并将其整合进一个包含风险规避套利者的国债市场动态均衡模型中。模型量化结果显示：（1）国债市场弹性存在陡峭的向下倾斜期限结构；（2）货币紧缩因套利者与高交叉弹性投资者的互动而推高期限溢价；（3）除非美联储可信地承诺持续扩表，否则量化宽松（QE）影响有限。

title: The long shadow of typhoons: Prenatal exposure and adult mental health
title_zh: 台风的长影：产前暴露与成年心理健康
title_primary: 台风的长影：产前暴露与成年心理健康
title_secondary: The long shadow of typhoons: Prenatal exposure and adult mental health
authors: Yu-Ting Huang, Elaine M. Liu, Jin-Tan Liu, Tzu-Yin Hazel Tseng
official: 官方在线 2026-08-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines how poor in utero conditions caused by severe typhoons affect psychological well-being later in life. We exploit variation in the timing and location of severe typhoon landfalls. Our design compares individuals with higher expected fetal exposure in landfall counties to those with no such exposure. A one-unit increase in expected in utero exposure raises the likelihood of an adult mental illness diagnosis by 2.2 percentage points, or 11 percent relative to the mean. The incidence of mood disorders such as depression and the use of antidepressants has risen by more than 50 percent. The adverse effects are concentrated among women. In a fully interacted model, we reject equality of the male and female effects for our main outcomes. This gender gap is not driven by differential healthcare-seeking behavior. We discuss several non-mutually exclusive mechanisms that could generate a genuinely female-concentrated effect, including sex-specific fetal programming and mortality selection
abstract_zh: 本文考察了由严重台风导致的恶劣宫内环境如何影响个体成年后的心理健康状况。我们利用严重台风登陆时间与地点的变异，将预期胎儿期暴露程度较高的登陆县个体与无此类暴露的个体进行比较。预期宫内暴露每增加一个单位，成年期精神疾病诊断的可能性提高2.2个百分点，相对于均值而言增加11%。情绪障碍（如抑郁症）的发病率及抗抑郁药物的使用量上升超过50%。不利影响主要集中在女性群体中。在完全交互模型中，我们拒绝了主要结局指标中男性和女性效应相等的假设。这一性别差异并非由就医行为的差异所驱动。我们讨论了若干非互斥的机制，这些机制可能产生真正集中于女性的效应，包括性别特异性胎儿编程和死亡选择。

title: Wage spillovers across sectors: Evidence from a localized public-sector wage cut
title_zh: 部门间工资溢出效应：基于局部公共部门减薪的证据

authors: Tsuyoshi Goto, Atsushi Yamagishi
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study how institutional wage reforms in one sector spill over to other sectors by focusing on the public sector. We leverage the Japanese policy reform that cut public-sector wages only in certain municipalities and the institutional setting in which only young workers are eligible for public-sector jobs. We find that a 1% public-sector wage cut reduces the private-sector wages of young workers by 0.3%. This spillover elasticity is greater when public-sector jobs are more important as workers’ outside options. We also find evidence that private-sector firms’ employment and profits expand in response to the public-sector wage cut. Previous article in issue Next article in issue
abstract_zh: 我们通过聚焦公共部门，研究了某一部门的制度性工资改革如何溢出至其他部门。我们利用日本仅针对特定市町村削减公共部门工资的政策改革，以及仅年轻工人有资格从事公共部门工作的制度安排。研究发现，公共部门工资每削减1%，年轻工人的私营部门工资将下降0.3%。当公共部门工作作为工人外部选择的重要性更高时，这一溢出弹性更大。我们还发现证据表明，私营企业就业和利润会因公共部门工资削减而扩张。

title: Help comes with friction: parental Co-residence and labour supply in migrant households
title_zh: 帮助伴随摩擦：流动家庭中的父母同住与劳动供给
title_primary: 帮助伴随摩擦：流动家庭中的父母同住与劳动供给
title_secondary: Help comes with friction: parental Co-residence and labour supply in migrant households
authors: Jingwen Tan
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This article examines how parental co-residence in the destination city is related to migrants’ labour supply. Using the 2018 China Migrants Dynamic Survey, the results show that parental co-residence is positively associated with migrants’ weekly working hours, and this relationship is mainly driven by relatively younger co-residing parents. To interpret the mechanism, the paper develops and estimates a structural time-allocation framework in which parents can substitute for household tasks but may also generate coordination costs within multigenerational households. The structural estimates suggest that parental assistance releases time for market work, while co-residence frictions partly offset these gains. Policy simulations further suggest that reducing household task burdens through market and community services may generate more stable labour-supply gains than relying only on family-based support. By linking empirical evidence with a structural time-allocation framework, this article contributes to the literature by showing that family support in migrant households is valuable but not costless, because parental co-residence simultaneously relaxes household task burdens and creates co-residence frictions. KEYWORDS: Migration labour supply intergenerational co-residence time allocation JEL CLASSIFICATION: J12 J13 J21 J22 J60
abstract_zh: 本文考察了父母在迁入地同住如何影响流动人口的劳动供给。基于2018年中国流动人口动态监测调查数据，研究发现父母同住与流动人口周工作小时数呈正相关，且这一关系主要由相对年轻的同住父母驱动。为解释其作用机制，本文构建并估计了一个结构性时间配置框架，在该框架中，父母可替代家务劳动，但也可能在多代同住家庭中产生协调成本。结构性估计结果表明，父母协助释放了市场劳动时间，但同住摩擦部分抵消了这些收益。政策模拟进一步显示，通过市场与社区服务减少家务负担，可能比单纯依赖家庭支持带来更稳定的劳动供给增益。通过将经验证据与结构性时间配置框架相结合，本文揭示了流动人口家庭中的家庭支持虽具价值但并非无成本——父母同住既缓解了家务负担，也产生了同住摩擦。关键词：迁移 劳动供给 代际同住 时间配置 JEL分类：J12 J13 J21 J22 J60

title: The Costs of Remoteness: Evidence from German Division and Reunification
title_zh: 偏远地区的代价：来自德国分裂与统一的证据
title_primary: 偏远地区的代价：来自德国分裂与统一的证据

authors: Stephen Redding, Daniel Sturm, Nadja Dwenger, Anna Gumpert, Moritz Hennicke 等
official: 官方在线 2005-04-23 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper exploits the division of Germany after the Second World War and the reunification of East and West Germany in 1990 as a natural experiment to provide evidence of the importance of market access for economic development. In line with a standard new economic geography model, we find that following division cities in West Germany that were close to the new border between East and West Germany experienced a substantial decline in population growth relative to other West German cities. We provide several pieces of evidence that the decline of the border cities can be entirely accounted for by their loss in market access and is neither driven by differences in industrial structure nor differences in the degree of war related destruction. Finally, we also find some first evidence of a recovery of the border cities after the reunification of East and West Germany.
abstract_zh: 本文利用二战后德国分裂及1990年东西德统一这一自然实验，为市场准入对经济发展的重要性提供了实证证据。与标准新经济地理模型一致，我们发现分裂后，西德境内靠近东西德新边界的城市相对于其他西德城市经历了显著的人口增长下降。我们提供多项证据表明，边境城市的衰退完全可归因于其市场准入的丧失，既非产业结构差异所致，亦非战争破坏程度差异造成。最后，我们还初步发现东西德统一后边境城市出现复苏的迹象。

title: Data trading platforms and corporate information disclosure quality: evidence from China
title_zh: 数据交易平台与企业信息披露质量：来自中国的证据

authors: Shinan Cao, Aruna, Xiangfei Li, Xiuting Qin, Aofei Zhu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-16 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper takes the establishment of China’s data trading platforms as a quasi-natural experiment, and examines their impacts on corporate information disclosure quality based on the data of listed companies from 2012 to 2025. The empirical results show that the launch of data trading platforms significantly improves the quality of corporate information disclosure, which verifies the positive effect of data on corporate information disclosure. Such platforms exert influences mainly through three channels: encouraging firms to accumulate high-quality data, improving their capabilities for information disclosure, and strengthening their willingness to disclose information. Further analysis indicates that the improvement in information disclosure quality can effectively reduce abnormal audit fees and alleviate corporate financing constraints. This paper provides a data-oriented theoretical perspective for research on information disclosure quality, and offers practical implications for the construction of data trading platforms and the optimization of corporate information disclosure.
abstract_zh: 本文以中国数据交易平台的设立为准自然实验，基于2012至2025年上市公司数据，考察其对信息披露质量的影响。实证结果表明，数据交易平台的启动显著提升了企业信息披露质量，验证了数据对企业信息披露的积极作用。此类平台主要通过三条渠道发挥作用：鼓励企业积累高质量数据、提升信息披露能力、以及增强信息披露意愿。进一步分析显示，信息披露质量的提升能够有效降低异常审计费用，并缓解企业融资约束。本文为信息披露质量研究提供了以数据为导向的理论视角，并对数据交易平台建设及企业信息披露优化具有实践启示。关键词：数据交易平台 信息披露质量 信息披露意愿 数据要素 JEL分类：G30 G40

title: Racial and Ethnic Inequality and the China Shock
title_zh: 种族与民族不平等及中国冲击
title_primary: 种族与民族不平等及中国冲击
title_secondary: Racial and Ethnic Inequality and the China Shock
authors: Kahn, Lisa B., Oldenski, Lindsay, Park, Geunyong
official: 卷期日期 2026-08-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Minority workers tend to be disproportionately harmed by negative economic shocks. Indeed, we show that Hispanic populations experienced worse employment losses due to import competition from China, relative to whites, largely due to lower education levels. In contrast, Black-white employment and wage gaps actually narrowed due to relative growth in non-manufacturing sectors. We show that Black workers were less attached to manufacturing by 2000, compared to whites, and were therefore more poised to take advantage of China shock induced reallocation to services. The lasting negative impacts of the China shock on exposed communities were primarily driven by white workers.
abstract_zh: 少数族裔工人往往在经济负面冲击中遭受不成比例的损害。事实上，我们表明，相较于白人，西班牙裔人口因中国进口竞争而面临更严重的就业损失，这主要归因于其较低的教育水平。相比之下，由于非制造业部门的相对增长，黑人与白人之间的就业和工资差距实际上有所缩小。我们指出，到2000年，黑人工人对制造业的依赖程度低于白人，因此他们更有能力利用中国冲击所引发的服务业重新配置。中国冲击对受影响社区造成的持久负面影响主要由白人工人驱动。

title: Optimal Taxation of Inflation
title_zh: 通货膨胀的最优税收
title_primary: 通货膨胀的最优税收
title_secondary: Optimal Taxation of Inflation
authors: Capelle, Damien, Liu, Yang
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper analyzes the effectiveness of a tax on inflation policy (TIP), which would require firms to pay a tax proportional to the increase in their prices or wages, in stabilizing inflation. We show that TIP would effectively correct externalities in firms’ pricing decisions, tackle excessive inflation and reduce output volatility. While proposals from the 1970s saw TIP as a substitute to MP, we find that they are complementary, with TIP addressing cost-push shocks, and MP addressing demand shocks. In sharp contrast with price controls, TIP doesn’t exacerbate relative price distortions.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了通胀税政策（TIP）在稳定通胀方面的有效性，该政策要求企业按其价格或工资上涨比例缴纳税款。研究表明，TIP能够有效纠正企业定价决策中的外部性，应对过度通胀并降低产出波动。尽管20世纪70年代的提案将TIP视为货币政策的替代方案，但我们发现二者具有互补性：TIP应对成本推动冲击，而货币政策应对需求冲击。与价格管制形成鲜明对比的是，TIP不会加剧相对价格扭曲。

title: Estimating present bias and sophistication over effort and money
title_zh: 估计努力和金钱上的现时偏向与成熟度
title_primary: 估计努力和金钱上的现时偏向与成熟度
title_secondary: Estimating present bias and sophistication over effort and money
authors: Claudia Cerrone, Anujit Chakraborty, Hyok Jung Kim, Leonhard K. Lades
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We design and conduct a real-effort experiment to jointly estimate present bias and sophistication across effort and monetary domains. Unlike prior work (e.g., Augenblick and Rabin, 2019; Fedyk, 2024), we do not assume that these parameters are identical across domains. We explain and empirically demonstrate how assuming identical sophistication across money and effort domains can bias the estimates of key parameters. In our online experiment, participants chose to (predicted to) complete 14% (10%) fewer tasks on the same day than on a future day, leading to an estimated present bias ( beta e $\beta_e$ β e ) over effort of 0.70–0.79, and an estimated sophistication ( beta caret e $\widehat{\beta}_e$ β ^ e ) of 0.80–0.88. For money, aggregate present bias ( beta m $\beta_m$ β m ) is near zero, but there is substantial heterogeneity, with roughly equal numbers of participants exhibiting present bias and future bias. At the individual level, roughly three quarters of all participants correctly anticipate the direction of their bias in both domains, even if not its full magnitude.
abstract_zh: 我们设计并实施了一项真实努力实验，以联合估计努力领域和货币领域中的现时偏向与老练程度。与先前研究（如Augenblick and Rabin, 2019; Fedyk, 2024）不同，我们并未假设这些参数在不同领域间具有一致性。我们解释并实证证明了：假设货币与努力领域的老练程度相同，会导致关键参数估计产生偏误。在我们的在线实验中，参与者当天完成的任务量比未来某天少14%（预测值为10%），由此估算的现时偏向系数接近于零，但存在显著的异质性——表现出现时偏向与未来偏向的参与者数量大致相当。在个体层面，约四分之三的参与者能正确预判自身在两个领域中的偏向方向，尽管未能完全预判其程度。

title: Making Teenagers Read Newspapers. A Nationwide Experiment in French High Schools
title_zh: 让青少年阅读报纸：法国高中的全国性实验
title_primary: 让青少年阅读报纸：法国高中的全国性实验
title_secondary: Making Teenagers Read Newspapers. A Nationwide Experiment in French High Schools
authors: Simon Briole, Julia Cage, Andrea Prat
official: 官方在线 2026-07-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Despite unprecedented access to information in the digital age, young citizens face growing challenges related to news consumption and misinformation. This large-scale randomized controlled trial examines the impact of two complementary interventions designed to foster media literacy and the consumption of high-quality news among high-school students, implemented in France over the 2024-25 academic year. The study involves 243 high schools (for a total number of 9,628 students), randomly assigned to a control group or to receive one or both of the following interventions: (i) a one-year free digital subscription to the leading national newspaper, and (ii) media education modules implemented by teachers. Exploiting unique data on students' actual online news consumption, we document a very large uptake of the free subscription, which translates into persistent and large increases in news consumption (+0.49 to 0.60 sd) and demand for future news, including an 8pp increase in paid subscriptions nearly a year after the intervention. We also observe a 0.20 to 0.31 sd increase in news knowledge for students enrolled in deprived schools, reducing baseline information inequality by 45-70%. Finally, we show that both free news access and media education improve media literacy skills (+0.08 to 0.26 sd), with larger effects among students taught by teachers with prior experience in media education.
abstract_zh: 尽管数字时代信息获取空前便捷，但年轻公民在新闻消费与应对虚假信息方面仍面临日益严峻的挑战。本项大规模随机对照试验考察了两项互补性干预措施的效果——旨在培养高中生媒介素养并促进高质量新闻消费，于2024-25学年在法国实施。研究涵盖243所高中（共计9,628名学生），随机分配至对照组或接受以下一项或两项干预：（i）为期一年的全国性主流报纸免费数字订阅；（ii）由教师实施的媒介教育模块。通过利用学生实际在线新闻消费的独特数据，我们发现免费订阅的采纳率极高，这转化为新闻消费的持续大幅增长（效应量0.49至0.60个标准差）及未来新闻需求的提升，包括干预实施近一年后付费订阅率增加8个百分点。在贫困学校就读的学生中，我们还观察到新闻知识水平提升0.20至0.31个标准差，使基线信息不平等程度降低45-70%。最后，研究表明免费新闻获取与媒介教育均能提升媒介素养技能（效应量0.08至0.26个标准差），且对由具备媒介教育经验的教师授课的学生影响更大。

title: Optimism, complementarity and welfare
title_zh: 乐观主义、互补性与福利
title_primary: 乐观主义、互补性与福利
title_secondary: Optimism, complementarity and welfare
authors: Raphael Galvão
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper studies how a government’s disclosure of information based on short-term reputation concerns can distort agents’ investment decisions and welfare. Agents receive public information before deciding whether to invest, and their actions are strategic complements. There are efficient and inefficient governments, and the high productivity state is more likely under the efficient type. Governments know the state and make public reports with the goal of being perceived as efficient. This motivation leads the inefficient type to be optimistic in equilibrium, sending false reports of the high productivity state with positive probability, thus distorting agents’ beliefs. When productivity is actually high, this distortion reduces investment and welfare compared to a truthful disclosure policy. However, I show that the inefficient type can improve welfare in the low productivity state by sending false reports (there is a small economic boom), as long as the trust in the report is not too high. As the trust in the false report rises, the bias in the agents’ beliefs becomes so large that welfare starts to decrease (the boom might turn into a crisis).
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了政府基于短期声誉考量进行信息披露，如何扭曲代理人的投资决策及社会福利。代理人在决定是否投资前接收公共信息，其行为具有战略互补性。存在高效与低效两类政府，且高效类型下高生产率状态更可能出现。政府知晓真实状态，并出于被视为高效的动机发布公开报告。这一动机导致低效类型在均衡中倾向于乐观，以正概率发送高生产率状态的虚假报告，从而扭曲代理人的信念。当生产率实际较高时，与真实披露政策相比，这种扭曲减少了投资和社会福利。然而，本文表明，只要对虚假报告的信任度不过高，低效类型在低生产率状态下发送虚假报告（引发小幅经济繁荣）可提升福利。随着对虚假报告信任度的上升，代理人信念的偏差变得过大，福利开始下降（繁荣可能转为危机）。

title: Mobile money and the social contract: Experimental evidence from Ghana
title_zh: 移动货币与社会契约：来自加纳的实验证据
title_primary: 移动货币与社会契约：来自加纳的实验证据
title_secondary: Mobile money and the social contract: Experimental evidence from Ghana
authors: Alex Yeandle, David Doyle
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Mobile money platforms are ubiquitous in many emerging economies. Hailed for raising financial inclusion and economic wellbeing, governments have now turned to mobile payments as a source of tax revenue. Transaction levies are often regressive, unpopular, and can encourage a return to cash. We present experimental evidence that they may also harm tax morale, a core component of the social contract between citizen and state. We present results from a survey experiment in Ghana, in which priming a controversial mobile transaction levy significantly lowers support for the state’s right to collect taxes and willingness to comply with tax laws. We combine this with focus group discussions and analyse effect heterogeneity to examine two pre-registered explanations: transaction taxes cost citizens more than they expect to gain (reciprocity) and provoke particular backlash from non-government voters (partisanship). Our findings suggest that taxing mobile money can undermine efforts to expand fiscal capacity, while raising important mechanistic and policy questions for future research.
abstract_zh: 移动货币平台在许多新兴经济体中无处不在。因其提升金融包容性和经济福祉而备受赞誉，各国政府现已转向移动支付作为税收来源。交易税往往具有累退性，不受欢迎，并可能促使人们回归现金使用。我们提供的实验证据表明，这类税收还可能损害税收道德，而税收道德是公民与国家之间社会契约的核心组成部分。我们展示了在加纳进行的一项调查实验结果，其中，引入一项有争议的移动交易税显著降低了公众对国家征税权的支持度以及遵守税法的意愿。我们将此与焦点小组讨论相结合，并分析效应异质性，以检验两项预先注册的解释：交易税给公民带来的成本超过其预期收益（互惠性），以及引发非政府选民特别强烈的反弹（党派性）。我们的研究结果表明，对移动货币征税可能削弱扩大财政能力的努力，同时为未来研究提出了重要的机制性和政策性问题。

title: The Survival of the Energy-Fittest: Evidence from French Manufacturing Firms
title_zh: 能源适者生存：来自法国制造业企业的证据
title_primary: 能源适者生存：来自法国制造业企业的证据

authors: Ara Jo, Sébastien Houde
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper proposes corrected forecast combinations when the original combined forecast errors are serially dependent. Motivated by the classic Bates and Granger (1969) example, we show that combined forecast errors can be strongly autocorrelated and that a simple correction - adding a fraction of the previous combined error to the next-period combined forecast - can deliver sizable improvements in forecast accuracy, often exceeding the original gains from combining. We formalize the approach within the conditional-risk framework of Gibbs and Vasnev (2024), in which the combined error decomposes into a predictable component (measurable at the forecast origin) and an innovation. We then link this correction to efficient estimation of combination weights under time-series dependence via GLS, allowing joint estimation of weights and an error-covariance structure. Using the U.S. Survey of Professional Forecasters for major macroeconomic indices across various subsamples (including pre/post-2000, GFC, and COVID), we find that a parsimonious correction of the mean forecast with a coefficient around 0.5 is a robust starting point and often yields material improvements in forecast accuracy. For optimal-weight forecasts, the correction substantially mitigates the forecast combination puzzle by turning poorly performing out-of-sample optimal-weight combinations into competitive forecasts.
abstract_zh: 本文区分了企业内部改进与企业间选择及市场再分配在决定总能源强度中的作用。我们的分析表明，尽管现有实证文献重点关注企业对气候政策措施的内部响应，但选择与市场再分配在推动总能源强度下降方面所起的作用强于企业内部改进。我们还发现，环境政策可以利用这些机制，尤其是选择渠道。

title: Unpacking the link between service sector and female employment: cross‐country evidence
title_zh: 服务业与女性就业关系的解析：跨国证据
title_primary: 服务业与女性就业关系的解析：跨国证据
title_secondary: Unpacking the link between service sector and female employment: cross‐country evidence
authors: Sena Coskun, Gonul Sengul
official: 官方在线 2026-06-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper documents significant cross-country variation in the strength of the service sector pulling women into the market work. We find the composition of the service sector to be the crucial driver of this heterogeneity. Specifically, a larger public administration sector is associated with lower elasticity, while a higher female share within business services has a positive association. The relationship between female share within business services and elasticity also depends on the size of the food and accommodation services, reflecting a marketization channel. Service sector composition alone explains 54% of the cross-country variation, rising to 60% when controlling for labour market policies. These findings show that the sub-sectoral structure of the service sector is the critical determinant of its ability to pull women into market work.
abstract_zh: 本文记录了服务业在吸引女性进入市场工作方面强度的显著跨国差异。我们发现，服务业的结构构成是这一异质性的关键驱动因素。具体而言，公共管理部门的规模越大，弹性越低，而商业服务中女性占比越高，则与更高的弹性正相关。商业服务中女性占比与弹性之间的关系还取决于食品和住宿服务业的规模，这反映了市场化渠道的作用。仅服务业构成一项就能解释跨国差异的54%，在控制劳动力市场政策后，这一比例升至60%。这些发现表明，服务业的分部门结构是决定其吸引女性进入市场工作能力的关键因素。

title: Duverger’s tilted balance: “Two-party system” operationalized
title_zh: 迪韦尔热的倾斜平衡：“两党制”的操作化
title_primary: 迪韦尔热的倾斜平衡：“两党制”的操作化
title_secondary: Duverger’s tilted balance: “Two-party system” operationalized
authors: Rein Taagepera
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: When single member plurality electoral rule is used, Duverger’s “law” posits prevalence of a “two-party system”. This system often has been construed to mean that Laakso-Taagepera effective number of parties is close to 2.0. But this can be misleading because N = 2.0 can result not only from 50–50-0 but also from 66.6–16.7–16.7. A safer index of “two-partyness” has been developed for district votes, but the issue is even more complex at the nationwide level. Here the Duvergerian ideal for seats in a single election is not stalemate (50–50-0) but a tilted balance: a comfortable majority, yet also vigorous opposition. Also needed are alternation in power and long-term parity in number of elections won. This study develops indices of closeness to these four ideals and applies them to a dataset. Results confirm a Duverger’s tendency, but it is too early to proclaim a Duverger’s law.
abstract_zh: 当采用单一成员多数决选举规则时，迪维尔热的“定律”预设了“两党制”的主导地位。这一制度常被解读为拉索-塔格佩拉有效政党数接近2.0。然而，这种解读可能具有误导性，因为N=2.0不仅可能源于50-50-0的分布，也可能来自66.6-16.7-16.7的情况。针对选区选票，已开发出更安全的“两党性”指标，但在全国层面，问题则更为复杂。在此，单次选举中议席的迪维尔热理想状态并非僵局（50-50-0），而是一种倾斜的平衡：既拥有舒适的多数，又存在有力的反对派。此外，还需要权力的交替更迭以及长期内赢得选举次数的均等。本研究开发了衡量接近这四种理想状态的指数，并将其应用于一个数据集。结果证实了迪维尔热的趋势，但宣称其为迪维尔热定律尚为时过早。

title: Macroeconomic Expectations and Credit Card Spending
title_zh: 宏观经济预期与信用卡支出
title_primary: 宏观经济预期与信用卡支出
title_secondary: Macroeconomic Expectations and Credit Card Spending
authors: Mikhail Galashin, Martin Kanz, Ricardo Perez-Truglia
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine how macroeconomic expectations affect consumer decisions, using an experiment with 2,872 credit card customers at a large commercial bank. In the experiment, participants are randomized into receiving expert forecasts of inflation and the nominal exchange rate. We find that forecasts shift inflation and exchange rate expectations, but do not change spending or self-reported consumption plans as predicted by standard models of intertemporal choice. Results from a supplementary survey experiment suggest that consumers are sophisticated enough to anticipate nominal rigidities and reduce spending on durables for precautionary reasons, counteracting the effects predicted by standard models of intertemporal optimization.
abstract_zh: 我们通过一项涉及某大型商业银行2872名信用卡客户的实验，考察宏观经济预期如何影响消费者决策。实验中，参与者被随机分配接收专家对通胀率和名义汇率的预测。研究发现，预测信息会改变通胀率和汇率预期，但并未如标准跨期选择模型所预测的那样改变支出或自我报告的消费计划。一项补充调查实验的结果表明，消费者足够成熟，能够预见到名义刚性，并出于预防性动机减少耐用品支出，从而抵消了标准跨期优化模型所预测的影响。

title: Wage insurance against short‐term sales changes
title_zh: 短期销售变化下的工资保险
title_primary: 短期销售变化下的工资保险
title_secondary: Wage insurance against short‐term sales changes
authors: Róbert Károlyi
official: 官方在线 2026-04-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In this paper, I study how the wages of job-stayers respond within the year to changes in firm sales, using quarterly matched employer–employee data from Hungary. The analysis compares firm-specific and sectoral shocks with an instrumental variables strategy based on leave-one-out sectoral sales growth. Three main results emerge. Wages are almost fully insured against idiosyncratic firm shocks, with elasticities around 2%. In contrast, wages co-move strongly with aggregate shocks: the elasticity with respect to sectoral sales changes is about 0.07, and even higher in manufacturing, construction and machine-operator jobs. These results show that aggregate shocks pass through even on a short, quarterly time horizon, while firms provide insurance against firm-specific shocks. This implies that changing macroeconomic or monetary conditions can affect wages even at the quarterly level.
abstract_zh: 本文利用匈牙利季度匹配的雇主-雇员数据，研究了留任员工工资如何随企业销售变化在年内作出反应。分析通过基于留一法部门销售增长的工具变量策略，比较了企业特定冲击与部门冲击。主要发现有三点：工资几乎完全抵御了企业特定冲击，弹性约为2%；相反，工资与总体冲击紧密联动，对部门销售变化的弹性约为0.07，在制造业、建筑业及机器操作岗位中甚至更高。这些结果表明，总体冲击即使在短期的季度时间跨度内也能传导至工资，而企业则针对特定冲击提供保险。这意味着宏观经济或货币条件的变化即使在季度层面也能影响工资水平。

title: Waiting for others: Long delays in social learning
title_zh: 等待他人：社会学习中的长时间延迟
title_primary: 等待他人：社会学习中的长时间延迟
title_secondary: Waiting for others: Long delays in social learning
authors: Luis Frones
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Does waiting to observe others’ actions delay profitable choices? If so, for how long? We study a social learning environment in which players decide whether and when to undertake an irreversible risky investment. The timing is asymmetric: some players face an investment opportunity earlier than others. We prove the existence of equilibria with arbitrarily long delays, where, with positive probability, the first investment occurs after several periods without investment. In these equilibria, the better-informed player need not invest first, delays may persist even when signals are highly precise, and their duration is independent of the number of players. We illustrate how this framework can help explain observed investment dynamics in the venture capital industry.
abstract_zh: 等待观察他人行动是否会延迟有利可图的选择？如果是，会延迟多久？我们研究了一个社会学习环境，其中玩家决定是否以及何时进行一项不可逆的风险投资。时间安排不对称：一些玩家比其他人更早面临投资机会。我们证明了存在任意长延迟的均衡，在这些均衡中，有正概率首次投资发生在几个无投资时期之后。在这些均衡中，信息更充分的玩家不一定首先投资，即使信号高度精确，延迟也可能持续存在，并且其持续时间与玩家数量无关。我们展示了这一框架如何有助于解释风险投资行业中观察到的投资动态。

title: Neural correlates of interactions between adaptive learning and hierarchical reasoning in repeated strategic games
title_zh: 重复策略博弈中适应性学习与层级推理交互作用的神经关联
title_primary: 重复策略博弈中适应性学习与层级推理交互作用的神经关联
title_secondary: Neural correlates of interactions between adaptive learning and hierarchical reasoning in repeated strategic games
authors: Jun Feng, Jia Jin, Sasa Zhao, Edmund Derrington, Xiangdong Qin 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Repeated strategic interactions with consistent partners involve both adaptive learning and hierarchical reasoning. Hybrid models that incorporate reasoning into adaptive learning paradigms have been proposed to capture these processes and their interactions at the behavioral level. Here, we employ model-based functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) to investigate the neural computations underlying decisions in repeated strategic interactions between two players using 11–20 money request games. A hybrid model explains medial prefrontal cortex activity more accurately than pure adaptive learning models. Additionally, we find that regions such as the rostral anterior cingulate, dorsolateral prefrontal cortex, right temporoparietal junction, precuneus, and anterior insula correlate with prediction error signals generated by adaptive, simulated adaptive, and sophisticated learning from the hybrid model. Together, our findings provide novel neural-level support for the interplay between adaptive learning and hierarchical reasoning in a repeated game with fixed partners.
abstract_zh: 与固定伙伴的重复策略互动涉及适应性学习与层级推理的双重过程。为捕捉这些过程及其在行为层面的交互，已有研究提出将推理融入适应性学习范式的混合模型。本研究采用基于模型的脑功能磁共振成像技术，通过11-20金钱请求游戏，探究两名玩家在重复策略互动中决策背后的神经计算机制。相较于纯适应性学习模型，混合模型能更精确地解释内侧前额叶皮层的活动。此外，我们发现喙侧前扣带回、背外侧前额叶、右侧颞顶联合区、楔前叶及前脑岛等区域的活动与混合模型产生的适应性、模拟适应性及复杂学习预测误差信号相关。综上，本研究为固定伙伴重复博弈中适应性学习与层级推理的相互作用提供了新的神经层面证据。

title: The profitability of managerial delegation with endogenous locations
title_zh: 内生选址下管理层授权的盈利能力
title_primary: 内生选址下管理层授权的盈利能力
title_secondary: The profitability of managerial delegation with endogenous locations
authors: Dang-Long Bui, Wen-Jung Liang, Yan-Shu Lin
official: 官方在线 2025-09-16 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Research on managerial delegation typically suggests that firms in a Cournot duopoly compete more aggressively in the product market post-delegation, causing their profits to decline. This paper investigates the profitability of delegation by incorporating a sales-delegation strategy into a spatial barbell model, where consumers are asymmetrically distributed at the two endpoints of a line segment. We find that the firm located closer to the more populated market may benefit from delegation. Notably, this occurs when the locational equilibrium shifts from agglomeration to separation following delegation. Although the firms compete more intensely under delegation, social welfare decreases when the locational equilibrium changes from separation to agglomeration and the transport rate is sufficiently high.
abstract_zh: 关于管理授权的研究通常表明，在古诺双寡头市场中，企业授权后会在产品市场上展开更激烈的竞争，导致其利润下降。本文通过将销售授权策略引入空间杠铃模型（其中消费者非对称地分布于线段两端）来研究授权的盈利性。研究发现，位于人口更密集市场附近的企业可能从授权中获益。值得注意的是，当授权导致区位均衡从集聚转向分离时，这一现象才会出现。尽管授权下企业竞争更为激烈，但当区位均衡从分离转向集聚且运输费率足够高时，社会福利反而会下降。
